National Association of Realtors | Chicago or Washington DC - ONSITE | Data Analyst | Full Time

We want Python + Pandas, SQL, statistics, data visualization and some AI; the usual data science stack. Job is in-depth data analysis across multiple data sets - the challenges change weekly. We're using Cursor for data science and AI is permeating all our analysis work - we're transforming from traditional data science to being AI-forward.

Job is here: https://realtors.applicantstack.com/x/detail/a2yfvt49zurx
